CREATE TABLE "public"."AccountTransfer" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  "recipientId" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  "respondedAt" timestamp(3),
  "senderId" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  "status" character varying(16) DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "summary" json NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."AccountTransferItem" (
  "accountId" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  "transferId" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."DetachedFinancialRecord" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "entityId" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  "entityType" character varying(40) NOT NULL,
  "id" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  "kind" character varying(32) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."DetachedRewardCredit" (
  "amount" numeric(20,8) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "date" date NOT NULL,
  "financialAccountId" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  "id" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "yieldPeriod" character varying(8),
  "yieldReferencePercentage" numeric(7,4),
  "yieldReferenceRate" numeric(7,4),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."NotificationDelivery" (
  "attempts" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "channel" character varying(12) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "destinationKey" text NOT NULL,
  "deviceId" character varying(36),
  "event" character varying(16) NOT NULL,
  "id" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  "lastError" character varying(500),
  "lockedUntil" timestamp(3),
  "nextAttemptAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "status" character varying(16) DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "transferId" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."PushDevice" (
  "address" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "credentials" json NOT NULL,
  "enabled" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "id" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  "platform" character varying(12) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
